description:
Printable binder covers for STEM subjects — a clean scientific-plate set for teacher binders, student binders, and classroom organization this back to school season.

Unlike floral or cartoon covers, these subject binder covers use real math and science formulas (Euler, ideal gas law, big-O, and more) with coordinated geometry motifs. Printable binder covers + spine labels included.

WHAT YOU GET (instant download)
• 12 STEM subject binder covers
  Mathematics · Algebra · Geometry · Calculus · Physics · Chemistry
  Biology · Computer Science · Statistics · Engineering · Lab · STEM
• Each cover in US Letter (8.5×11 in) and A4
• Matching binder spine labels / inserts
• 300 DPI JPG — print at home or a copy shop

HOW TO USE
Print at 100% scale (actual size). Slide into the clear front pocket of a 3-ring binder. Trim spine labels for the spine pocket.

Perfect for:
• Teacher binder organization
